name: Rolen Depot Work Shirt (Patched)
description: A faded grey-green button-up work shirt, originally issued by Rolen Depot to warehouse staff, now three owners and a hundred washes removed from new. The left elbow has been patched twice with mismatched brown synth-canvas; two buttons are replacements in a slightly wrong shade. Collar is frayed but structurally intact.
functionality: Durable long-sleeve coverage with chest pocket; holds up to daily labor and acid-light drizzle.
what_it_says: You work, you survive, you don't waste anything that still has life in it.
story_hooks: The previous owner's name — 'SULLY' — is still written in permanent marker inside the collar.
A folded scrap of paper tucked in the chest pocket contains half a map to somewhere.
